name: The Great Ursera Spirit
summary: A druid sends you to meet Urs'endris, a spirit on Zephras who has taught druids the ursera shape for generations. His domain is withering, and Urs'endris can guide your studies further.

sections.title: The Great Spirit
sections.body: A druid sends you to Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar. Your druidic studies have brought you to a meeting with one of Zephras's great spirits. Urs'endris has taught druids to take the ursera shape for generations, and his domain is withering into the sky.

faq.answer: Urs'endris is a wise spirit on Zephras who has taught druids to take the ursera shape for generations.
Urs'endris is near the falls northeast of Valanaar, near the Shrine of Akir.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to Urs'endris?
faq.answer: Your druidic studies have progressed enough for you to meet one of Zephras's great spirits, and Urs'endris can instruct you further.

faq.q: What is happening to Urs'endris's domain?
faq.answer: Urs'endris's domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky.
The ursera shape is a form Urs'endris has taught druids to take for generations.

angles.text: As a druid, your studies have brought you to Urs'endris, who has taught druids the ursera shape for generations.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Ursera Spirit
